title: dryopteris auriculata
intro: Dryopteris auriculata, commonly known as auriculated wood fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of D. auriculata include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of D. auriculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential health benefits.
